name: mapbox_geocode
description: Convert a street address to GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude). Essential for YardSync job locations.

name: mapbox_reverse_geocode
description: Convert GPS coordinates to a street address

name: mapbox_batch_geocode
description: Geocode multiple addresses at once. Returns coordinates for each address.

name: mapbox_get_directions
description: Get driving/walking/cycling directions between two or more locations. Returns distance, duration, and route geometry.

name: mapbox_optimize_route
description: Find the most efficient route through multiple stops (traveling salesman). Great for YardSync multi-stop driver routes.

waypoints.description: Array of {longitude, latitude} — first is origin

name: mapbox_get_matrix
description: Get a matrix of travel times and distances between multiple origins and destinations

name: mapbox_get_isochrone
description: Get a polygon showing all areas reachable within a given drive time or distance from a point

name: mapbox_get_service_area
description: Get service area polygons (15, 30, 60-minute drive radii) from a location. Use for YardSync coverage zones.

name: mapbox_get_static_map_url
description: Generate a static map image URL showing markers and a location. Use in emails and dashboards.

name: mapbox_get_route_map_url
description: Generate a static map image URL showing a route between two points with markers

name: mapbox_validate_address
description: Validate whether an address exists and is deliverable. Returns confidence score and normalized address.

name: mapbox_calculate_distance
description: Calculate the straight-line distance in miles and km between two GPS coordinates

name: mapbox_search_nearby
description: Search for places or businesses near a specific location

name: mapbox_get_place_details
description: Get details about a specific place by name including coordinates and address

name: mapbox_plan_driver_stops
description: YardSync compound tool: geocode all delivery addresses, then return an optimized multi-stop driver route with total distance and time
